title: The Hero has Arrived!
overview: The hero of Biscotti is back and this time he is not alone, he has brought 2 new Heroes to compete in war!

title: Pastillage Joins the Fight!
overview: The current ruler of Pastillage is jealous of those competing in the war. After she catches a glimpse of Rebecca, she is determined to make her a Knight.

title: Three Heroes!
overview: Rebecca has taken to the skies and Pastillage has official joined the war. Her skill as a mage and playing video games quickly turns the tide of the battle.

title: Biscotti Summer Camp!
overview: With the war games over each Princess has gone back to their respective kingdoms. Sink, along with friends, are spending their time training in counter-monster skills.

title: Galette Sword Style Record!
overview: Highway Bandits are ruining the lives of the people in Ayase. Nana, Vert, and Jau head out to stop the bandits but meet a much more interesting character.

title: Pastillage's Hero King Legend
overview: Couverte and Sink have accidently released the Demon King from his sleep. Even with all the heroes powers combined he proves to be a formidable enemy. Only the Hero King can stop his rampage.

title: Battle at the Cave of Sealing!
overview: A seal in a cave of monsters has been broken leaving the Heroes of old to call in the new generation.

title: Esnart Arts and Music Festival
overview: The festival is in danger due to the abilities of an unexpected guest.

title: Union Fest
overview: A new war between the nations is about to begin but Biscotti's Captain of the Imperial Guard is having problems that will lead Biscotti into ruin.

title: One-On-One In The Skies and On Land
overview: One on one battles continue with Becky vs. Millihiore, Rebecca vs. Hina, and Sink vs. Gaul. A wild card appears to shake the battle up even more.

title: Change My Heart
overview: The Union Festival comes to a close, and Millihi and Sink take some time to relax at Yukikaze's house. But things take an unexpected turn when Millihi finds a strange crystal, and the three are engulfed in a blue fog...

title: Final Stage
overview: Wanting to get a gift for Rebecca, Couverte along with Rico and Noir descend into the vault underneath Castle Eschenbach. All the traps should be disabled in this ancient maze, right?

title: Summer Memories
overview: The Heroes Return home and reminisce.
